name: mock-transport
task_summary: Build mock Tauri IPC backend for live demo

spawn_spec.prompt:
Repo root: /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. Two sibling Vite React TS projects: `ui/` (desktop app, REAL components, read-only reference) and `site/` (landing page, where you edit). The landing page will reuse real UI components from `../ui/src/*` (alias `@ui` already wired in site's vite.config.ts and tsconfig.json).

GOAL: Implement an in-browser mock of the Tauri IPC layer so that real `ui/` components run unmodified inside the plain-browser landing page. All `ui/` code imports `invoke` from `@tauri-apps/api/core` and `listen`/`emit` from `@tauri-apps/api/event`; we intercept those two modules via Vite aliases.

CREATE these new files under `site/src/mock/`:

1. `site/src/mock/backend.ts` — the mock backend state machine. Read the exact payload/command types from `ui/src/lib/types.ts` and `ui/src/lib/tauri.ts` FIRST and match their shapes exactly (do NOT invent field names). It must cover this enumerated IPC surface (verified by grepping ui/src):
   - Commands: cmd_project_register, cmd_project_branches, cmd_worktree_list, cmd_worktree_status, cmd_worktree_create, cmd_worktree_delete, cmd_worktree_delete_preview, cmd_worktree_delete_destructive, cmd_terminal_spawn, cmd_terminal_list, cmd_terminal_write, cmd_terminal_resize, cmd_terminal_signal, cmd_terminal_get_cwd, cmd_terminal_close, cmd_terminal_preferences, cmd_browser_create, cmd_browser_navigate, cmd_browser_reload, cmd_browser_get_state, cmd_browser_list, cmd_browser_set_bounds, cmd_browser_set_visible, cmd_browser_set_zoom, cmd_browser_focus, cmd_browser_close, cmd_browser_open_external, cmd_remote_status, cmd_remote_enable, cmd_remote_disable, cmd_remote_pairing_create, cmd_remote_devices, cmd_remote_device_revoke, cmd_tailscale_status.
   - Events emitted TO the frontend: "terminal_output" (payload TerminalOutputPayload), "terminal_lifecycle" (TerminalLifecyclePayload), "menu_new_terminal_tab" (void), "worktree_changed" (WorktreeChangedPayload).
   Behavior:
   - Worktrees: two entries — repo root "." on branch main, and one sibling worktree on branch "feature/live-demo". Fields per the Worktree type.
   - Fake PTY: `cmd_terminal_spawn` registers a session id, emits terminal_lifecycle "working", then emits an initial prompt line (e.g. `ferryx on git:main % `) via terminal_output. `cmd_terminal_write` echoes typed characters back through terminal_output (PTY-style local echo); on newline, interpret the accumulated line as a shell command and emit plausible multi-line output for: ls, pwd, git status, git branch, git log --oneline, cargo test, bun test, echo <args>, help, clear. Unknown commands emit `<cmd>: command not found`, then re-print the prompt. Keep the fake shell state (cwd string) per session.
   - Browser commands: maintain an in-memory Map of BrowserState objects; create/navigate/reload/get/list/set_bounds/set_visible/set_zoom/focus/close/open_external all operate on that map and return correct shapes.
   - Remote/tailscale: status disabled/stopped; cmd_remote_pairing_create returns a fixed pairing code shape ("4F2A-91") matching the type in ui/src/lib/types.ts.
   - Unknown command name: reject with a descriptive Error (so missing coverage surfaces loudly).
2. `site/src/mock/core.ts` — drop-in shim for `@tauri-apps/api/core`: export `function invoke<T>(cmd: string, args?: unknown): Promise<T>` routing into backend.ts, plus export `const isTauri = false` (check ui usage of isTauri in lib/tauri.ts and match its expected semantics so guards behave sanely in browser).
3. `site/src/mock/events.ts` — drop-in shim for `@tauri-apps/api/event`: export `listen<T>(event, handler): Promise<UnlistenFn>`, `emit`, `emitTo` backed by an internal event bus in backend.ts. Match the real signatures loosely but compatibly (UnlistenFn = () => void).
4. Edit `site/vite.config.ts`: add aliases mapping `"@tauri-apps/api/core"` -> `site/src/mock/core.ts` and `"@tauri-apps/api/event"` -> `site/src/mock/events.ts`. These object keys must be listed BEFORE any catch-all patterns so they win resolution. Also add `"@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog"` -> a tiny `site/src/mock/dialog.ts` stub (export async function open(): Promise<null>) IF grep shows any component in the import graph of Sidebar.tsx / TabBar.tsx / TerminalSplitView.tsx uses it; only add if reachable.

VERIFY:
- `cd /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/site && bun run build` exits 0.
- Write NO demo components yet; no changes to site's existing components.
- Do NOT modify anything under `ui/` or `src-tauri/`.

Report: files created, how the fake shell dispatch works, and any type mismatches between your mocks and ui/src/lib/types.ts you had to resolve.
